newsitem.title: USA: Percon sees results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Percon sees results below expectations.

text.p: Percon Inc said its operating results for the second half of calendar 1996 would be below analysts' expectations.

The company said in a statement sales for the third quarter ending September 30 would most likely be in the range of $5.2 million to $5.6 million with earnings in the range of $0.10 to $0.12 per share. The company plans to release results for the quarter on October 29.

Mike Coughlin, Percon's president and chief executive, said: "Results for the third quarter of 1996 will fall short of expectations due in large part to traditionally slow business activity in July and August by Percon's French subsidiary, STI S.A.

"Input device sales into our distribution channels have also dropped off faster than anticipated. In addition, this is the first quarter in the last seven consecutive quarters in which Percon did not have large unit order transactions."

"... For the fourth quarter of 1996 we expect revenues to be below analyst estimates for similar reasons but the effect on earnings should be mitigated by decreases in operating expenses and increases in gross margin."
